description: This 3D model showcases a striking red cape draped over a futuristic black rack labeled 'CAPE RACK 9000'. The cape is the dominant visual element, with its vibrant red fabric catching the light and casting a strong shadow. The rack itself is angular and modern, with glowing teal text indicating its product name. A subtle circular glow emanates from behind the cape, suggesting it might be illuminated or set against a luminous backdrop. The overall presentation is sleek and eye-catching, likely intended for a modern or themed setting where it serves both a functional and decorative purpose.
